HomeOpenHint: Select an article to read it.
ArticleNotFoundMessage: No article lives at this address.
CreateArticleAuthRequiredMessage: Sign in (and become an author) to start writing.
CreateArticleAuthorRequiredMessage: Only authors can publish articles. Become an author first.
MarkdownContentFinishedLabel: Content is committed. Editing again restarts the buffer.
MarkdownContentEditingLabel: Add your markdown line by line, then press Finish content.
MarkdownContentRequiredMessage: Article content is empty - add at least one line.
AboutWhatBody: A small, self-hosted blogging platform: articles by independent authors, served through a gateway to readers anywhere.
AboutReadingBody: Browse highlights and the full article list on the home screen. Open any article to read it right here in the terminal.
AboutWritingBody: Sign in with your reader account, become an author, and publish markdown articles. Authors manage their own content.
LoginOtpHint: Enter the email of your reader account and the one-time code you received.
LoginPasskeyUnsupportedMessage: Passkeys need a browser WebAuthn stack and are not available in the terminal.
LoginPasskeyUseOtpMessage: Use the authenticator (one-time code) method instead.
LoginExternalUnsupportedMessage: External providers complete in a browser. The terminal opens the sign-in URL; after confirming there, sign in here with a one-time code.
LoginExternalHint: The provider page cannot redirect back into the terminal - use the emailed code to finish.
RegisterInitialEmailConsentLabel: You will receive a confirmation email with your verification token.
RegistrationStepCheckingAccountExists: Checking whether the account already exists...
RegisterConfirmBody2: Check your inbox: the confirmation email contains your verification token and a link that completes the registration.
RegisterConfirmBody3: Complete the registration (authenticator setup) and then sign in.
CompleteRegistrationMissingTokenMessage: Missing Email or VerificationToken in the link. Open the link from the confirmation email.
CompleteRegistrationDoneMessage: Registration complete! You can now sign in with a one-time code.
CompleteRegistrationPasskeyUnsupportedMe: Passkey setup needs a browser WebAuthn stack; use the authenticator (TOTP) method.
CompleteRegistrationAuthenticatorSetupHi: Set up an authenticator app to finish the registration.
CompleteRegistrationSecretHint: Add the secret to your authenticator app (scan the otpauth URI in a browser if you prefer the QR code), then enter a 6-digit code.
BecomeAuthorWelcomeMessage: Welcome aboard - you are an author now!
BecomeAuthorNotLoggedInMessage: Sign in with your reader account to become an author.
BecomeAuthorAlreadyAuthorMessage: You are already an author. Time to write!
BecomeAuthorFaqAnswer1: Every signed-in reader account. Converting keeps your reader account intact.
BecomeAuthorFaqAnswer2: Write markdown articles, categorize and tag them, and publish them to all readers.
BecomeAuthorErrorDisplayName: Display name must not be empty.
BecomeAuthorErrorUserId: Could not resolve your reader account id from the session.
